title: FlatJai: agent observability
description: Runs, stages, model and tool calls, and answer quality, from FlatJai's own traces in Postgres.

list.name: source
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM obs.runs ORDER BY 1 DESC
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM obs.runs ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Runs: every brief and reply, live from this laptop plus the TACC runs

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, count(*) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC
SELECT source, 100.0 * avg((status = 'done')::int) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

panels.title: Asked a question first
panels.description: The brief lacked a budget or campus, so the agent asked once instead of guessing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, 100.0 * avg((status = 'needs_input')::int) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC
SELECT source, 100.0 * avg((status = 'error')::int) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

SELECT source, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status = 'done' AND seconds < 600 GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

panels.title: p95 time per brief
panels.description: Runs stop at the 240 s budget (RUN_MAX_SECONDS) and answer with what they have.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status = 'done' AND seconds < 600 GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

SELECT source, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'model')::float / count(DISTINCT run_id) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC
SELECT source, sum(tokens_in + tokens_out)::float / count(DISTINCT run_id) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

panels.title: Output tokens / s
panels.description: Tokens written per second of model-call time, reading the prompt included (8B: Ollama on a 16 GB Mac; 27B: vLLM, AWQ INT4, 2 GPUs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, 1000.0 * sum(tokens_out) / nullif(sum(ms), 0) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND kind = 'model' AND tokens_out > 0 GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

SELECT source, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'tool')::float / count(DISTINCT run_id) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at)  GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

panels.title: Tool cache hits
panels.description: Searches, pages, geocodes and routes answered from the cache (the frozen snapshot in evaluation runs).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, 100.0 * avg((attrs->>'cache' = 'hit')::int) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND kind = 'tool' GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC

panels.title: Replies repaired
panels.description: Typed calls whose first reply failed the JSON schema and needed the one repair retry.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, 100.0 * avg(((attrs->>'attempts')::int > 1)::int) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND kind = 'model' GROUP BY source ORDER BY source DESC
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1h'), status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time per brief (each dot is a run that returned a shortlist; resumed runs left out)

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, source AS metric, seconds AS value FROM obs.runs WHERE source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) AND status = 'done' AND seconds < 600 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the time goes: the seven stages
Seconds per run in each stage (average)
panels.description: Read (fetch, extract and verify each new page) takes the most time on both models.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS stage, sum(ms) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 8B (laptop)') / 1000.0 / nullif(count(DISTINCT run_id) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 8B (laptop)'), 0) AS "Qwen 8B (laptop)", sum(ms) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 27B (TACC)') / 1000.0 / nullif(count(DISTINCT run_id) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 27B (TACC)'), 0) AS "Qwen 27B (TACC)" FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'stage' AND parent_id IS NULL AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY name ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['understand','plan','search','read','match','reflect','answer'], name::text)

panels.title: Stage timings
panels.description: Median and p95 are per stage visit; a run can plan, read and reflect more than once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Stage", source AS "Model", sum(ms) / 1000.0 / count(DISTINCT run_id) AS "Per run s", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) / 1000 AS "Median s", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) / 1000 AS "p95 s", 100.0 * sum(ms) / sum(sum(ms)) OVER (PARTITION BY source) AS "Share of time" FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'stage' AND parent_id IS NULL AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY name, source ORDER BY source DESC, array_position(ARRAY['understand','plan','search','read','match','reflect','answer'], name::text)

panels.title: Model calls: every typed call through ModelClient
Model calls by purpose
panels.description: Cancelled: stopped on purpose, when enough homes were found or the time budget ran out.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Call", source AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) / 1000 AS "Median s", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) / 1000 AS "p95 s", avg(tokens_in) AS "Tokens in", avg(tokens_out) AS "Tokens out", 1000.0 * sum(tokens_out) / nullif(sum(ms) FILTER (WHERE tokens_out > 0), 0) AS "Tokens / s", 100.0 * avg(((attrs->>'attempts')::int > 1)::int) AS "Repaired", 100.0 * avg((attrs->>'cancelled' IS NOT NULL)::int) AS "Cancelled" FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'model' AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY name, source ORDER BY source DESC, count(*) DESC

panels.title: Output tokens per call-second over time
panels.description: A drop on the laptop means memory pressure: other apps running beside Ollama.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(started_at, '1h'), source AS metric, 1000.0 * sum(tokens_out) / nullif(sum(ms), 0) AS value FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'model' AND tokens_out > 0 AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Tools: search, fetch, geocode, route, commute
Tool calls
panels.description: Not in snapshot: an offline run asked for a page the frozen market never saw; it is skipped, never fetched.

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS "Tool", source AS "Model", count(*) AS "Calls", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "Median ms", percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "p95 ms", 100.0 * avg((attrs->>'cache' = 'hit')::int) AS "Cache hits", count(*) FILTER (WHERE attrs->>'cache' = 'miss-offline') AS "Not in snapshot", count(*) FILTER (WHERE error IS NOT NULL) AS "Errors" FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'tool' AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY name, source ORDER BY source DESC, count(*) DESC

SELECT name AS tool, 100.0 * avg((attrs->>'cache' = 'hit')::int) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 8B (laptop)') AS "Qwen 8B (laptop)", 100.0 * avg((attrs->>'cache' = 'hit')::int) FILTER (WHERE source = 'Qwen 27B (TACC)') AS "Qwen 27B (TACC)" FROM obs.spans WHERE kind = 'tool' AND attrs->>'cache' IS NOT NULL AND source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Answer quality: the scored suite (E1 systems, E2 ablations, E3 on 27B), same formulas as eval/score.py
Within limits, invented facts and outcome by system
panels.description: 8B: Qwen 8B on the laptop; 27B: Qwen 27B on TACC. b0: the model alone. b1: one search, the top pages, one answer. flatjai-X: FlatJai with part X switched off.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN source LIKE '%27B%' THEN '27B ' ELSE '8B ' END || system AS system,  100.0 * (1 - sum(violated)::float / nullif(sum(homes), 0)) AS "Within limits", 100.0 * sum(confirmed)::float / nullif(sum(homes), 0) AS "All limits confirmed", 100.0 * (1 - sum(supported)::float / nullif(sum(facts), 0)) AS "Invented facts", 100.0 * avg(outcome_ok::int) AS "Outcome ok" FROM obs.eval GROUP BY source, system ORDER BY source DESC, array_position(ARRAY['flatjai','b1','b0'], system), system

panels.title: Scored suite
panels.description: One row per scored brief and repeat (8B ran E1 three times); Median s is wall time per brief.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source AS "Model", system AS "System", sum(homes) AS "Homes shown",  100.0 * (1 - sum(violated)::float / nullif(sum(homes), 0)) AS "Within limits", 100.0 * sum(confirmed)::float / nullif(sum(homes), 0) AS "All limits confirmed", 100.0 * (1 - sum(supported)::float / nullif(sum(facts), 0)) AS "Invented facts", 100.0 * avg(outcome_ok::int) AS "Outcome ok", 100.0 * sum(duplicates)::float / nullif(sum(homes), 0) AS "Duplicates", 100.0 * sum(cost_off)::float / nullif(sum(cost_figures), 0) AS "Costs off the tool", percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY seconds) AS "Median s" FROM obs.eval GROUP BY source, system ORDER BY source DESC, array_position(ARRAY['flatjai','b1','b0'], system), system

panels.title: Slowest runs in the time range (click a run id to open its trace)
panels.description: Runs resumed after a restart (over 10 min) are left out. The run inspector (make web) holds laptop runs only; TACC runs live in eval/results/tacc-*/flatjai.db.

targets.rawSql: WITH m AS (SELECT run_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'model') AS calls, sum(tokens_in + tokens_out) AS tokens, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'tool') AS tools FROM obs.spans GROUP BY run_id) SELECT r.started_at AS "Started", r.source AS "Model", r.status AS "Status", r.seconds AS "Seconds", m.calls AS "Model calls", m.tools AS "Tool calls", m.tokens AS "Tokens", r.id AS "Run", r.brief AS "Brief" FROM obs.runs r LEFT JOIN m ON m.run_id = r.id WHERE r.source IN ($source) AND $__timeFilter(r.started_at) AND r.seconds < 600 ORDER BY r.seconds DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
